Fresh Mint & Lemon Iced Tea
By: Julia
Published: Thursday, July 28, 2016 - 10:12am

Ingredients




8-10 Sprigs Fresh Mint, rinsed
1 Lemon
Honey, to Taste
Ice Cubes
1 liter (4 cups) Water

Preparation

1 Place the mint sprigs in a large heatproof jug/pitcher. Boil the water and pour it into the jug/pitcher. Let it steep for 30 minutes. 2 Once the water is warm (not hot) add in a tablespoon of honey and mix until the honey has dissolved. 3 Place the jug in your fridge to chill. Keep it in the fridge until you are ready to serve. 4 Right before serving, squeeze in some lemon juice (don’t put too much, maybe ¼ of a lemon – taste it first before adding more) and mix well. 5 Serve with a few slices of lemon, mint leaves and ice.

About

This fresh mint and lemon iced tea is a great summer drink! It’s refreshing! It’s healthy! It’s low in calories!
